I'm excited to share more about the Senior People &amp; Talent Operations Partner role and our team.</p> <h3>About TestGorilla</h3> <p>At TestGorilla, we're on a mission to place 1 billion people in their dream jobs. To democratize opportunity, we're building the world's leading skills-based talent discovery platform - one that replaces reliance on resumes with scientific validation of what people can truly do.</p> <p>Founded as a 100% remote company in 2020, our global team is united by high standards, a lot of heart, and a relentless drive to conquer new technological frontiers. We're all AI-fluent builders who care deeply about replacing bias with fairness.</p> <p>After empowering thousands of companies to hire smarter and faster, we're now unlocking the next phase of our scale-up journey - where you'll play an instrumental role in creating a world where skills matter most!</p> <h3>About the role</h3> <p>As our Senior People &amp; Talent Operations Partner, you'll own People Ops as a product: the systems, compliance, and self-serve workflows that let most of People &amp; Culture run itself day to day, plus the tooling behind how we hire. You'll join a lean, two-person team, working directly with me, with proper and lasting ownership from day one.&nbsp;</p> <p>Payroll, compliance, and HR systems across every (35, currently!) country we operate in are foundational elements of this role. Just as critically, you'll build and own the AI/automation and self-serve layer that keeps our People function lean, bringing a product mindset to everything you touch.&nbsp; Let’s face it: we’re a scale-up, so you’ll also need to be happy wearing other People hats when the moment requires.</p> <p>We're looking for someone autonomous, opinionated and candid, who'll tell me when I've got it wrong. You'll be dealing with real people and real problems, so you'll need to stay empathic but boundaried, structured and organized even when the pace picks up.</p> <p>I’m biased, but I think it’s a dream job: this is an HR role in an HRTech company changing the world of work for the better, we’ll have immense amounts of fun, there’s plenty of uncharted territory for you to make your own, and I’m committed to helping you to do the best work of your life.</p> <p><strong>A quick check:</strong> if you've never built objectively clever automations (not just used one someone else built), this probably isn't the role for you.
